let mode = 'solo';

function show(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(e => e.classList.toggle('active', e.id === id));
  screen = id;
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'instant' });
}

function safeImage(id){
 const img=images[assetKey(id)];
 return img?.complete&&img.naturalWidth?img:null;
}

function roster() {
  $('roster').innerHTML = '';
  fighters.forEach((f, i) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'fighterCard'
      + (picks[0] === i ? ' selectedP1' : '')
      + (picks[1] === i ? ' selectedP2' : '')
      + (picks[0] === i && picks[1] === i ? ' selectedBoth' : '');
    b.innerHTML = `
      <img loading="lazy" src="${assetURL(f.id)}" alt="${f.name}">
      <label>${f.name}</label>
      ${picks[0] === i ? '<span class="flag">P1</span>' : picks[1] === i ? `<span class="flag cpu">${mode === 'solo' ? 'CPU' : 'P2'}</span>` : ''}
    `;
    b.setAttribute('aria-label',f.name + (![0,4].includes(i) ? ' locked in demo' : ''));
    if (![0,4].includes(i)) { b.disabled = true; b.classList.add('demoLocked'); b.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="demoLockTag">FULL GAME</span>'); }
    b.onclick = () => {
      music.sfx('select');
      if (mode === 'solo') {
        picks[0] = i;
        if (picks[1] === i) picks[1] = randomCpu([i]);
        chooseStep = 0;
      } else if (chooseStep === 0) {
        picks[0] = i;
        chooseStep = 1;
      } else {
        picks[1] = i;
        chooseStep = 0;
      }
      updateSelect();
    };
    $('roster').append(b);
  });
}

function randomCpu(exclude = []) {
  const pool = [0,4].filter(i => !exclude.includes(i));
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}

function updateSelect() {
  roster();
  ['preview1', 'preview2'].forEach((id, p) => {
    $(id).src = assetURL(fighters[picks[p]].id);
    $(id).alt = fighters[picks[p]].name;
  });
  $('p1name').textContent = fighters[picks[0]].name;
  $('p2name').textContent = fighters[picks[1]].name;
  $('p1type').textContent = `${fighters[picks[0]].type} · ${fighters[picks[0]].trait}`;
  $('p2type').textContent = `${fighters[picks[1]].type} · ${fighters[picks[1]].trait}`;
  $('p2label').textContent = mode === 'solo' ? 'RANDOM CPU · EASY' : 'PLAYER 2';
  $('selectInstructions').textContent = mode === 'solo'
    ? 'FREE DEMO · BAGWIS & BAKAL · MANILA · FIRST TO 2 ROUND WINS'
    : chooseStep === 0 ? 'CHOOSE PLAYER 1 (BLUE) · THEN PLAYER 2 (RED)' : 'NOW CHOOSE PLAYER 2 (RED)';
  $('matchSummary').textContent = `P1: ${fighters[picks[0]].name}   VS   ${mode === 'solo' ? 'CPU' : 'P2'}: ${fighters[picks[1]].name}`;
  $('stageEyebrow').textContent = mode === 'solo' ? 'DEMO STAGE · MANILA' : 'CHOOSE YOUR BATTLEGROUND';
  $('stageHeading').innerHTML = mode === 'solo' ? 'DEMO <span>STAGE</span>' : 'STAGE <span>SELECT</span>';
}

function stageCards() {
  $('stages').innerHTML = '';
  stages.forEach((s, i) => {
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'stageCard' + (selectedStage === i ? ' activeStage' : '');
    const label = mode === 'solo' ? `${i + 1}. ${s.short} · ${CPU_LEVELS[i].name}` : s.short;
    b.innerHTML = `<img src="${assetURL(`stage-${s.id}`)}" loading="lazy" alt="${s.name} battle artwork"><b>${label}</b>`;
    b.disabled = mode === 'solo';
    b.setAttribute('aria-label', label);
    b.onclick = () => {
      if (mode === 'solo') return;
      selectedStage = i;
      stageCards();
    };
    $('stages').append(b);
  });
}

function resetLaunchButton() {
  $('startBtn').disabled = false;
  $('startBtn').textContent = 'ENTER THE ARENA →';
  $('rematchBtn').disabled = false;
}

function openSelect(m) {
  matchLaunch++;
  clearInputs();
  paused = false;
  game = null;
  arcade = null;
  mode = m;
  chooseStep = 0;
  selectedStage = 0;
  picks = [0, m === 'solo' ? randomCpu([0]) : 1];
  resetLaunchButton();
  music.init();
  startSoundtrack(0);
  updateSelect();
  stageCards();
  show('select');
}

function leaveMatch() {
  matchLaunch++;
  clearInputs();
  paused = false;
  game = null;
  arcade = null;
  chooseStep = 0;
  if (mode === 'solo') {
    selectedStage = 0;
    picks[1] = randomCpu([picks[0]]);
  }
  resetLaunchButton();
  $('resultOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  $('pauseOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  updateSelect();
  stageCards();
  show('select');
  startSoundtrack(0);
}

$('soloBtn').onclick = () => openSelect('solo');
$('duoBtn').onclick = () => openSelect('duo');
$('backMenu').onclick = () => {
  matchLaunch++;
  resetLaunchButton();
  show('menu');
  startSoundtrack(0);
};
$('startBtn').onclick = () => startMatch();
$('audioBtn').onclick = () => {
  audioEnabled = !audioEnabled;
  $('audioBtn').textContent = audioEnabled ? '♫ SOUND ON' : '♫ SOUND OFF';
  music.stop();
  if (audioEnabled) { music.init(); startSoundtrack(); } else soundtrack.pause();
};
$('fightExit').onclick = leaveMatch;
$('resumeBtn').onclick = () => togglePause(false);
$('quitBtn').onclick = leaveMatch;
$('reselectBtn').onclick = leaveMatch;
$('rematchBtn').onclick = () => {
  if (!game || !game.over) return;
  if (game.state === 'stageclear') return advanceStage();
  if (game.cpu && game.winner === 0) picks[1] = randomCpu([picks[0], picks[1]]);
  return startMatch({ keepArcade: game.cpu && game.winner === 1 });
};

function canPauseGame() {
  return game && (!game.over || game.state === 'stageclear');
}


function clearInputs(){
 keys.clear();edge.clear();padPrevious=[{},{}];
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-key]').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('pressed'));
 if(game)for(const p of [game.a,game.b])p.inputQueue=[];
}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(screen!=='fight'||!game)return;
 if(e.code==='Escape'||e.code==='KeyP'){
   e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat&&canPauseGame())togglePause();return;
 }
 if(paused)return;
 const gameKeys=['ArrowUp','ArrowDown','ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Space','KeyA','KeyD','KeyW','KeyS','KeyF','KeyG','KeyT','KeyH','KeyR','KeyJ','KeyK','KeyO','KeyL','KeyI'];
 if(gameKeys.includes(e.code))e.preventDefault();
 if(!keys.has(e.code))edge.add(e.code);keys.add(e.code);
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys.delete(e.code));
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{clearInputs();if(screen==='fight'&&canPauseGame())togglePause(true);});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){clearInputs();if(screen==='fight'&&canPauseGame())togglePause(true);}});
for(const b of document.querySelectorAll('[data-key]')){
 const key=b.dataset.key;
 b.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
   if(paused)return;e.preventDefault();b.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);
   if(!keys.has(key))edge.add(key);keys.add(key);b.classList.add('pressed');
 });
 for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])b.addEventListener(ev,e=>{e.preventDefault();keys.delete(key);b.classList.remove('pressed');});
}

function togglePause(force) {
  clearInputs();
  paused = typeof force === 'boolean' ? force : !paused;
  $('pauseOverlay').classList.toggle('hidden', !paused);
  if (paused) soundtrack.pause();
  else startSoundtrack();
}

class SynthMusic {
  constructor() {
    this.ctx = null;
    this.timer = null;
    this.step = 0;
    this.master = null;
    this.root = 41;
    this.bpm = 112;
  }
  init() {
    if (!audioEnabled) return;
    const A = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!A) return;
    if (!this.ctx) {
      this.ctx = new A();
      this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
      this.master.gain.value = 0.22;
      const comp = this.ctx.createDynamicsCompressor();
      comp.threshold.value = -19;
      comp.ratio.value = 7;
      this.master.connect(comp);
      comp.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    }
    this.ctx.resume();
  }
  tone(freq, t, duration = 0.15, vol = 0.25, type = 'sawtooth', endFreq) {
    if (!this.ctx || !audioEnabled) return;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const g = this.ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(Math.max(freq, 30), t);
    if (endFreq) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(endFreq, 30), t + duration * 0.87);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(vol, 0.003), t + 0.008);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + duration);
    osc.connect(g);
    g.connect(this.master);
    osc.start(t);
    osc.stop(t + duration + 0.015);
  }
  noise(t, d = 0.1, vol = 0.13, highpass = 900) {
    if (!this.ctx || !audioEnabled) return;
    const len = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.ctx.sampleRate * d));
    const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, len, this.ctx.sampleRate);
    const arr = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) arr[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    const s = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
    const filter = this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
    const g = this.ctx.createGain();
    s.buffer = buffer;
    filter.type = 'highpass';
    filter.frequency.value = highpass;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + d);
    s.connect(filter);
    filter.connect(g);
    g.connect(this.master);
    s.start(t);
    s.stop(t + d);
  }
  sfx(name) {
    if (!audioEnabled) return;
    this.init();
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    if (name === 'light') {
      this.noise(t, 0.075, 0.23, 850);
      this.tone(200, t, 0.09, 0.16, 'sawtooth', 90);
    } else if (name === 'heavy') {
      this.noise(t, 0.18, 0.36, 500);
      this.tone(150, t, 0.20, 0.40, 'sawtooth', 47);
    } else if (name === 'special') {
      this.tone(510, t, 0.36, 0.23, 'sawtooth', 150);
      this.tone(770, t + 0.06, 0.31, 0.19, 'sine', 300);
      this.noise(t, 0.3, 0.19, 1300);
    } else if (name === 'super') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) this.tone(165 + i * 75, t + i * 0.085, 0.36, 0.27, 'sawtooth', 70 + i * 20);
      this.noise(t + 0.2, 0.52, 0.41, 350);
    } else if (name === 'block') {
      this.tone(550, t, 0.10, 0.25, 'square', 200);
    } else if (name === 'jump') {
      this.tone(260, t, 0.13, 0.12, 'sine', 430);
    } else if (name === 'round') {
      this.tone(440, t, 0.4, 0.17, 'triangle', 660);
      this.tone(660, t + 0.18, 0.5, 0.22, 'triangle', 880);
    } else if (name === 'ko') {
      this.tone(180, t, 0.75, 0.34, 'sawtooth', 49);
      this.noise(t, 0.5, 0.25, 200);
    } else if (name === 'select') {
      this.tone(700, t, 0.12, 0.08, 'sine', 980);
    }
  }
  start(stage = stages[selectedStage]) {
    this.stop();
    if (!audioEnabled) return;
    this.init();
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    this.root = stage.root;
    this.bpm = stage.bpm;
    this.step = 0;
    const stepMs = 60000 / this.bpm / 4;
    this.timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (!this.ctx || !audioEnabled || screen !== 'fight' || paused) return;
      const t = this.ctx.currentTime + 0.015;
      const i = this.step++ % 32;
      const scale = [0, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17];
      const semi = scale[Math.floor(i / 2) % scale.length];
      const freq = 55 * 2 ** ((this.root - 33 + semi) / 12);
      if (i % 4 === 0) this.tone(60, t, 0.23, 0.22, 'sine', 35);
      if (i % 8 === 4) this.noise(t, 0.17, 0.15, 600);
      if (i % 2 === 0) this.noise(t, 0.045, 0.040, 3000);
      if (i % 4 === 0) this.tone(freq / 2, t, 0.34, 0.11, 'sawtooth', freq / 2 * 0.98);
      if ([0, 7, 12, 16, 23, 28].includes(i)) this.tone(freq * 2, t, 0.28, 0.07, 'triangle', freq * 1.98);
    }, stepMs);
  }
  stop() {
    if (this.timer) clearInterval(this.timer);
    this.timer = null;
  }
}

const music = new SynthMusic();
const soundtrack = document.getElementById('victoryRun');
const STAGE_TRACKS = [{name:'Victory Run',src:soundtrack.getAttribute('src')}];
let currentTrack = 0;
let helpPaused = false;
soundtrack.volume = .52;
function startSoundtrack(stageIndex = game?.stageIndex ?? 0) {
  const index = Math.max(0, Math.min(STAGE_TRACKS.length - 1, stageIndex));
  if (index !== currentTrack) {
    soundtrack.pause();
    currentTrack = index;
    soundtrack.src = STAGE_TRACKS[index].src;
    soundtrack.load();
  }
  if (audioEnabled && !paused) soundtrack.play().catch(() => {});
}



function entity(char, x, side) {
  return {
    c: char,
    x,
    y: floorY(),
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    move: 0,
    side,
    face: side === 0 ? 1 : -1,
    hp: 100,
    maxHP: 100,
    meter: 18,
    stun: 0,
    invul: 0,
    blocking: false,
    attack: null,
    attackCooldown: 0,
    anim: 0,
    grounded: true,
    combo: 0,
    comboTimer: 0,
    aiCooldown: 0,
    aiChoice: 0,
    flash: 0,
    trail: [],
    down: false,
    land: 0,
    dust: 0,
    gait: 0,
    inputQueue: [],
    dashTime: 0,
    dashLock: 0,
    poseKey: '',
    previousPose: '',
    poseTransition: 0,
    auraPulse: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    callout: { text: '', t: 0 }
  };
}

async function startMatch({ keepArcade = false } = {}) {
  const launch = ++matchLaunch;
  const button = $('startBtn');
  button.disabled = true;
  button.textContent = 'PREPARING ARENA…';
  $('rematchBtn').disabled = true;
  music.init();
  await assetsReady;
  if (document.fonts) await document.fonts.load('900 24px Arcade');
  if (launch !== matchLaunch) return;
  if (assetFailures.length) {
    resetLaunchButton();
    button.textContent = 'Unable to load artwork — reopen the file';
    return;
  }
  if (mode === 'solo') {
    if (!keepArcade || !arcade) {
      if (picks[1] === picks[0]) picks[1] = randomCpu([picks[0]]);
      arcade = { index: 0, player: picks[0], used: [picks[1]] };
    }
    picks[0] = arcade.player;
    selectedStage = arcade.index;
  } else arcade = null;
  resetLaunchButton();
  game = null;
  hitStop = 0;
  accumulator = 0;
  stageClock = 0;
  game = {
    a: entity(fighters[picks[0]], 330, 0),
    b: entity(fighters[picks[1]], 950, 1),
    round: 1,
    wins: [0, 0],
    timer: 75,
    state: 'intro',
    intro: 2.1,
    over: false,
    intermission: 0,
    stage: stages[selectedStage],
    stageIndex: selectedStage,
    cpu: mode === 'solo',
    difficulty: mode === 'solo' ? CPU_LEVELS[arcade.index] : null,
    winner: null,
    nextStage: null,
    nextTimer: 0,
    advancing: false
  };
  particles = [];
  visuals = [];
  shake = 0;
  paused = false;
  clearInputs();
  $('pauseOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  $('resultOverlay').classList.add('hidden');
  $('stageCountdown').textContent = '';
  $('stageLabel').textContent = game.cpu ? `STAGE ${selectedStage + 1} / 1 · ${game.stage.name}` : game.stage.name;
  $('fightMode').textContent = game.cpu ? `1 PLAYER · ${game.difficulty.name} CPU` : '2 PLAYER · LOCAL VS';
  $('p2touch').style.display = mode === 'duo' ? 'flex' : 'none';
  show('fight');
  canvas.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  startSoundtrack(selectedStage);
  last = performance.now();
  if (!rafId) rafId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

async function advanceStage() {
  if (!game || game.state !== 'stageclear' || game.advancing || !arcade) return;
  game.advancing = true;
  arcade.index = game.nextStage.index;
  picks[1] = game.nextStage.opponent;
  arcade.used.push(picks[1]);
  return startMatch({ keepArcade: true });
}


function roundReset() {
  keys.clear();edge.clear();hitStop=0;
  game.a = entity(fighters[picks[0]], 330, 0);
  game.b = entity(fighters[picks[1]], 950, 1);
  game.a.meter = 20;
  game.b.meter = 20;
  game.timer = 75;
  game.state = 'intro';
  game.intro = 2.1;
  particles = [];
  visuals = [];
  music.sfx('round');
}

const controls = [
  { left: 'KeyA', right: 'KeyD', jump: 'KeyW', block: 'KeyS', light: 'KeyF', heavy: 'KeyG', kick: 'KeyT', special: 'KeyH', super: 'KeyR' },
  { left: 'ArrowLeft', right: 'ArrowRight', jump: 'ArrowUp', block: 'ArrowDown', light: 'KeyJ', heavy: 'KeyK', kick: 'KeyO', special: 'KeyL', super: 'KeyI' }
];

function readGamepads() {
  const arr = navigator.getGamepads?.() || [];
  for (let p = 0; p < Math.min(2, arr.length); p++) {
    const pad = arr[p];
    if (!pad) continue;
    const c = controls[p];
    const prev = padPrevious[p];
    const ax = pad.axes?.[0] || 0;
    const map = {
      [c.left]: ax < -0.36 || pad.buttons[14]?.pressed,
      [c.right]: ax > 0.36 || pad.buttons[15]?.pressed,
      [c.jump]: pad.buttons[12]?.pressed,
      [c.block]: pad.buttons[6]?.pressed,
      [c.light]: pad.buttons[0]?.pressed,
      [c.heavy]: pad.buttons[1]?.pressed,
      [c.kick]: pad.buttons[5]?.pressed,
      [c.special]: pad.buttons[2]?.pressed,
      [c.super]: pad.buttons[3]?.pressed
    };
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(map)) {
      if (val) {
        if (!prev[key]) edge.add(key);
        keys.add(key);
      } else if (prev[key]) {
        keys.delete(key);
      }
      prev[key] = !!val;
    }
  }
}

function spawn(x, y, color, n = 10, power = 1) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const v = (50 + Math.random() * 250) * power;
    particles.push({
      x,
      y,
      vx: Math.cos(a) * v,
      vy: Math.sin(a) * v - 90,
      t: 0.32 + Math.random() * 0.45,
      life: 0.8,
      color,
      r: 2 + Math.random() * 5
    });
  }
}

function pulse(x, y, color, size = 130) {
  visuals.push({ x, y, color, size, time: 0.36, life: 0.36 });
}

function attack(p, kind) {
  if (game.state !== 'play' || p.stun > 0 || p.attackCooldown > 0 || p.down) return;
  const specs = {
    light: { damage: 7, start: 0.085, active: 0.12, end: 0.18, reach: p.c.reach + 50, cost: 0, knock: 165 },
    kick: { damage: 11, start: 0.12, active: 0.18, end: 0.25, reach: p.c.reach + 84, cost: 0, knock: 255 },
    heavy: { damage: 13, start: 0.17, active: 0.16, end: 0.33, reach: p.c.reach + 68, cost: 0, knock: 305 },
    special: { damage: 19, start: 0.18, active: 0.29, end: 0.35, reach: p.c.reach + 145, cost: 25, knock: 410 },
    super: { damage: 37, start: 0.29, active: 0.48, end: 0.55, reach: p.c.reach + 280, cost: 80, knock: 600 }
  };
  const s = specs[kind];
  if (p.meter < s.cost) return;
  p.meter -= s.cost;
  p.blocking=false;
  p.attack = { kind, s, t: 0, hit: false };
  p.attackCooldown = s.start + s.active + s.end;
  p.vx = 0;
  p.anim += 0.4;
  if (kind === 'special' || kind === 'super') {
    p.callout.text = p.c.moves[kind];
    p.callout.t = kind === 'super' ? 1.1 : 0.65;
  }
  music.sfx(kind);
  // NO persistent or start-up effects. Hit sparks are spawned only if contact is confirmed.
}

function hit(att, def, s) {
  if (att.attack?.hit || def.invul > 0) return;
  const blocking = def.blocking && def.grounded && def.stun <= 0;
  const dmg = s.damage * att.c.power;
  def.hp = Math.max(0, def.hp - dmg * (blocking ? 0.16 : 1));
  if (blocking) {
    def.meter = Math.min(100, def.meter + 3);
    def.vx = att.face * 80;
    spawn(def.x - att.face * 28, def.y - def.c.spriteHeight*.65, '#a1dfff', 10);
    pulse(def.x - att.face * 28, def.y - def.c.spriteHeight*.65, '#a1dfff', 72);
    music.sfx('block');
  } else {
    def.attack=null;def.attackCooldown=0;def.inputQueue=[];
    hitStop=att.attack.kind==='super'?.09:att.attack.kind==='heavy'?.065:.042;
    def.stun = att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 0.78 : ['heavy','kick'].includes(att.attack.kind) ? 0.37 : 0.20;
    def.vx = att.face * s.knock;
    def.vy = att.attack.kind === 'super' ? -235 : def.vy;
    def.meter = Math.min(100, def.meter + 7);
    att.combo++;
    att.comboTimer = 1.35;
    def.flash = 0.14;
    // VFX are independent of clean poses and only fire on a confirmed punch/kick/special HIT.
    const cx = def.x - att.face * 26;
    const cy = def.y - def.c.spriteHeight*(att.attack.kind==='kick'?.47:.70);
    spawn(cx, cy, att.c.glow, att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 70 : 23, att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 1.9 : 1);
    pulse(cx, cy, att.c.glow, att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 240 : att.attack.kind === 'special' ? 158 : 82);
    shake = att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 10 : att.attack.kind === 'heavy' ? 5 : 2.5;
    music.sfx(att.attack.kind === 'light' ? 'light' : 'heavy');
  }
  att.meter = Math.min(100, att.meter + (blocking ? 3 : att.attack.kind === 'super' ? 0 : 8));
  att.attack.hit = true;
  if (def.hp <= 0) {
    game.state = 'ko';
    game.intermission = 3.25;
    shake = 9;
    music.sfx('ko');
    def.down = true;
    // K.O. reuses the confirmed impact; no independent ambient fighter effects.
  }
}

function aiInput(p, o, dt) {
  const c = controls[1];
  const level = game.difficulty || CPU_LEVELS[0];
  // Decisions are sampled at a human-sized reaction interval, then held.
  for (const k of Object.values(c)) keys.delete(k);
  if (p.stun > 0 || p.down) { p.aiDecision = null; return; }
  p.aiCooldown -= dt;
  if (p.aiCooldown <= 0) {
    p.aiCooldown = level.reaction * (.8 + Math.random() * .4);
    const dist = Math.abs(p.x - o.x);
    const forward = o.x > p.x ? 1 : -1;
    const threatened = o.attack && dist < o.attack.s.reach + 25;
    const block = p.grounded && !p.attack && threatened && Math.random() < level.guard;
    let move = dist > p.c.reach + 38 ? forward : 0;
    if (dist < 122 && Math.random() < level.retreat) move = -forward;
    if (block) move = 0;
    p.aiDecision = { move, block };
    if (!block && !p.attack && p.attackCooldown <= 0) {
      if (p.grounded && dist > 180 && dist < 420 && Math.random() < level.jump) edge.add(c.jump);
      if (dist < p.c.reach + 200 && Math.random() < level.attack) {
        const r = Math.random();
        let kind;
        if (p.meter >= 80 && r < level.super && dist < p.c.reach + 260) kind = 'super';
        else if (p.meter >= 25 && r < level.special && dist < p.c.reach + 145) kind = 'special';
        else if (dist < p.c.reach + 48) kind = r < .5 ? 'light' : r < .76 ? 'kick' : 'heavy';
        else if (dist < p.c.reach + 80) kind = 'kick';
        if (kind) edge.add(c[kind]);
      }
    }
  }
  const decision = p.aiDecision;
  if (decision?.block) keys.add(c.block);
  if (decision?.move) keys.add(decision.move > 0 ? c.right : c.left);
}


function bufferInputs(p,control,dt) {
  for(const name of ['jump','super','special','kick','heavy','light']) {
    if(edge.has(control[name])) {
      p.inputQueue=p.inputQueue.filter(i=>i.name!==name);
      p.inputQueue.push({name,ttl:.2});
    }
  }
  p.inputQueue=p.inputQueue.filter(i=>(i.ttl-=dt)>0).slice(-3);
}

function updateFighter(p,o,control,dt) {
  p.anim+=dt;
  for(const name of ['attackCooldown','stun','invul','comboTimer','flash','land','dashTime','aiHitLock'])p[name]=Math.max(0,(p[name]||0)-dt);
  p.callout.t=Math.max(0,p.callout.t-dt);
  if(!p.comboTimer)p.combo=0;
  // Lock attack direction through recovery; turn toward opponent when free.
  if(!p.attack && !p.down && Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>4)p.face=o.x>p.x?1:-1;
  bufferInputs(p,control,dt);
  p.blocking=keys.has(control.block)&&p.grounded&&!p.attack&&p.stun===0&&!p.down;
  const dir=(keys.has(control.right)?1:0)-(keys.has(control.left)?1:0);
  if(p.stun===0&&!p.attack&&!p.blocking&&!p.down) {
    const speed=p.c.speed*(p.grounded?1:.90)*(dir*p.face<0?.84:1);
    p.vx+=(dir*speed-p.vx)*Math.min(1,(p.grounded?19:6)*dt);
    if(!dir&&p.grounded)p.vx*=Math.exp(-18*dt);
    p.move+=(dir-p.move)*Math.min(1,dt*18);
    const jump=p.inputQueue.findIndex(i=>i.name==='jump');
    if(jump>=0&&p.grounded&&p.land<.06) {
      p.inputQueue.splice(jump,1);p.vy=-710;p.grounded=false;p.land=0;music.sfx('jump');
    }
    const next=p.inputQueue.findIndex(i=>i.name!=='jump');
    if(next>=0&&p.attackCooldown===0) {
      const item=p.inputQueue.splice(next,1)[0];attack(p,item.name);
    }
  } else {
    p.move*=Math.exp(-16*dt);
    if(p.blocking)p.vx*=Math.exp(-22*dt);
    else if(p.stun>0)p.vx*=Math.exp(-7*dt);
  }
  if(Math.abs(p.vx)<2&&!dir)p.vx=0;
  // Advance walk frames by distance, so a stopped fighter never cycles feet.
  if(p.grounded&&!p.attack&&!p.blocking&&p.stun===0)p.gait+=Math.abs(p.vx)*dt/34*(p.vx*p.face<0?-1:1);
  if(p.attack) {
    p.attack.t+=dt;
    const {s,t,hit:didHit,kind}=p.attack;
    if(t>=s.start&&t<s.start+s.active&&!didHit) {
      const forward=(o.x-p.x)*p.face;
      const attackY=p.y-(kind==='kick'?p.c.spriteHeight*.47:p.c.spriteHeight*.70);
      const defenderTop=o.y-o.c.spriteHeight*.88;
      const defenderBottom=o.y-25;
      if(forward>0&&forward<s.reach&&attackY>defenderTop&&attackY<defenderBottom)hit(p,o,s);
    }
    if((kind==='special'||kind==='super')&&t<s.start+s.active)p.x+=p.face*(kind==='super'?190:120)*dt;
    if(t>=s.start+s.active+s.end){p.attack=null;p.attackCooldown=0;}
  }
  const wasGrounded=p.grounded;
  p.vy+=1650*dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;
  if(p.y>=floorY()) {
    p.y=floorY();p.vy=0;p.grounded=true;
    if(!wasGrounded){p.land=.10;music.sfx('land');}
  } else p.grounded=false;
  p.x=Math.max(220,Math.min(W-220,p.x));
}

function separateFighters() {
  const a=game.a,b=game.b;
  // Permit jump-overs. Grounded bodies cannot pass through one another.
  if(Math.abs(a.y-b.y)>85)return;
  const overlap=114-Math.abs(a.x-b.x);
  if(overlap<=0)return;
  const dir=a.x<b.x?-1:1;
  a.x+=dir*overlap/2;b.x-=dir*overlap/2;
  for(const p of [a,b])p.x=Math.max(220,Math.min(W-220,p.x));
  if(Math.abs(a.x-b.x)<114){
    if(a.x<b.x){if(a.x===220)b.x=a.x+114;else a.x=b.x-114;}
    else {if(b.x===220)a.x=b.x+114;else b.x=a.x-114;}
  }
}

function nextRound() {
  const a = game.a, b = game.b;
  const winner = a.hp === b.hp ? (a.meter >= b.meter ? 0 : 1) : (a.hp > b.hp ? 0 : 1);
  game.wins[winner]++;
  if (game.wins[winner] < ROUNDS_TO_WIN) {
    game.round++;
    roundReset();
    return;
  }
  game.over = true;
  game.state = 'end';
  game.winner = winner;
  clearInputs();
  music.stop();
  particles = [];
  visuals = [];
  shake = 0;
  const f = winner === 0 ? a : b;
  const score = `${game.wins[0]} — ${game.wins[1]}`;
  $('winnerLabel').textContent = `${f.c.name} WINS!`;
  $('winnerDetail').textContent = `${score} · ${game.stage.name}`;
  $('resultEyebrow').textContent = 'MATCH COMPLETE';
  $('stageCountdown').textContent = '';
  $('rematchBtn').textContent = '↻ REMATCH';
  if (game.cpu && winner === 0 && arcade.index < stages.length - 1) {
    const next = arcade.index + 1;
    const opponent = randomCpu([arcade.player, ...arcade.used]);
    game.state = 'stageclear';
    game.nextStage = { index: next, opponent };
    game.nextTimer = 3.2;
    $('resultEyebrow').textContent = `STAGE ${arcade.index + 1} CLEAR · ${score}`;
    $('winnerDetail').textContent = `NEXT: ${stages[next].short} · ${fighters[opponent].name} · ${CPU_LEVELS[next].name} CPU`;
    $('stageCountdown').textContent = 'NEXT STAGE IN 4';
    $('rematchBtn').textContent = 'NEXT STAGE →';
  } else if (game.cpu && winner === 0) {
    $('resultEyebrow').textContent = 'DEMO COMPLETE · FULL GAME COMING SOON';
    $('winnerLabel').textContent = 'DEMO COMPLETE!';
    $('winnerDetail').textContent = `${f.c.name} · CHAMPION OF THE ISLANDS · ${score}`;
    $('rematchBtn').textContent = '↻ PLAY DEMO AGAIN';
  } else if (game.cpu) {
    $('resultEyebrow').textContent = `STAGE ${arcade.index + 1} · ${game.difficulty.name} CPU`;
    $('rematchBtn').textContent = '↻ RETRY THIS STAGE';
  }
  $('rematchBtn').disabled = false;
  $('resultOverlay').classList.remove('hidden');
}


function update(dt) {
  if(!game||paused)return;
  stageClock+=dt;
  if(game.over){
    game.a.anim+=dt;game.b.anim+=dt;edge.clear();
    if(game.state==='stageclear'&&!game.advancing){
      game.nextTimer=Math.max(0,game.nextTimer-dt);
      const message=`NEXT STAGE IN ${Math.ceil(game.nextTimer)}`;
      if($('stageCountdown').textContent!==message)$('stageCountdown').textContent=message;
      if(game.nextTimer<=0)advanceStage();
    }
    return;
  }
  readGamepads();
  if(hitStop>0){hitStop=Math.max(0,hitStop-dt);return;}
  if(game.state==='intro') {
    game.a.anim+=dt;game.b.anim+=dt;
    game.intro-=dt;
    if(game.intro<=0){game.state='play';music.sfx('round');}
  } else if(game.state==='play') {
    game.timer-=dt;
    if(game.cpu)aiInput(game.b,game.a,dt);
    updateFighter(game.a,game.b,controls[0],dt);
    if(game.state==='play')updateFighter(game.b,game.a,controls[1],dt);
    separateFighters();
    if(game.timer<=0){game.timer=0;game.state='ko';game.intermission=2.6;music.sfx('ko');}
  } else if(game.state==='ko') {
    game.a.anim+=dt;game.b.anim+=dt;
    for(const p of [game.a,game.b]) {
      p.attack=null;p.flash=Math.max(0,p.flash-dt);p.callout.t=0;
      if(p.y<floorY()){p.vy+=1650*dt;p.y=Math.min(floorY(),p.y+p.vy*dt);}
    }
    game.intermission-=dt;if(game.intermission<=0)nextRound();
  }
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=500*dt;p.t-=dt;}
  particles=particles.filter(p=>p.t>0).slice(-240);
  for(const v of visuals)v.time-=dt;
  visuals=visuals.filter(v=>v.time>0);
  shake=Math.max(0,shake-70*dt);
  edge.clear();
}

function rect(x, y, w, h, color) {
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, h);
}

function text(t, x, y, size, color = '#fff', align = 'center', font = 'Arcade', weight = 900) {
  ctx.textAlign = align;
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.font = `${weight} ${size}px "${font}",Impact,sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.fillText(t, x, y);
}

// All action sprites use the same right-facing camera. Mirror once, from the
// opponent's position, independently of travel direction (including backsteps).
function fighterPose(p) {
  if (p.down) return 'hurt';
  if (((game.state === 'end' || game.state === 'stageclear') && game.winner === p.side) || (game.state === 'ko' && !p.down && p.hp > (p.side ? game.a.hp : game.b.hp))) return 'victory';
  if (p.stun > 0) return 'hurt';
  if (p.attack) {
    const {kind,s,t}=p.attack;
    if(t < s.start) return kind==='kick' ? 'kickReady' : 'windup';
    if(t < s.start+s.active) return kind;
    const recovery=(t-s.start-s.active)/s.end;
    if(recovery < .4) return kind;
    if(recovery < .72) return kind==='kick' ? 'kickReady' : 'windup';
    return 'idle';
  }
  if (!p.grounded) return 'jump';
  if (p.land > 0.055) return 'land';
  if (p.blocking) return 'guard';
  if (Math.abs(p.vx)>20 || Math.abs(p.move)>.2) {
    const phase=((Math.floor(p.gait)%4)+4)%4;
    return `walk${phase}`;
  }
  return 'idle';
}

function fighterSprite(p) {
  const pose=fighterPose(p);
  p.poseKey=pose;
  const key=assetKey(`${p.c.id}-${pose}`);
  const img=safeImage(key), m=SPRITE_META[key];
  if(!img || !m)return;
  const scale=p.c.spriteHeight/m.baseHeight;
  const air=Math.max(0,floorY()-p.y);
  const shadowScale=Math.max(.45,1-air/520);
  ctx.save();
  const shadow=ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x,floorY()+1,1,p.x,floorY()+1,p.c.shadow);
  shadow.addColorStop(0,`rgba(0,4,12,${.46*shadowScale})`);
  shadow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,4,12,0)');
  ctx.translate(p.x,floorY()+1);ctx.scale(shadowScale,.16*shadowScale);
  ctx.fillStyle=shadow; // centered local fill below uses its own coordinates
  const localShadow=ctx.createRadialGradient(0,0,0,0,0,p.c.shadow);
  localShadow.addColorStop(0,`rgba(0,4,12,${.52*shadowScale})`);
  localShadow.addColorStop(.5,`rgba(0,4,12,${.27*shadowScale})`);
  localShadow.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,4,12,0)');
  ctx.fillStyle=localShadow;ctx.fillRect(-p.c.shadow,-p.c.shadow,p.c.shadow*2,p.c.shadow*2);
  ctx.restore();

  let stretch=1,lean=0,offset=0;
  if(p.grounded && !p.attack && !p.down) {
    // Breathe/squash around the sole anchor; never translate feet off the floor.
    stretch=1+Math.sin(p.anim*3.8+p.side)*.006;
    if(pose.startsWith('walk'))stretch-=Math.abs(Math.sin(p.gait*Math.PI))*.009;
  }
  if(p.attack) {
    const {s,t,kind}=p.attack;
    const power=kind==='super'?15:kind==='special'?11:kind==='heavy'?7:4;
    if(t<s.start)offset=-3*Math.sin(t/s.start*Math.PI/2);
    else if(t<s.start+s.active)offset=power*Math.sin((t-s.start)/s.active*Math.PI);
    else offset=power*.2*Math.max(0,1-(t-s.start-s.active)/s.end);
  }
  if(p.down)lean=-1.16;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(p.x,p.y);
  ctx.scale(p.face*scale,scale*stretch);
  // A slight shear gives follow-through while preserving the planted foot.
  if(!p.down && p.attack)ctx.transform(1,0,-offset/(m.h*scale),1,0,0);
  if(p.down){ctx.translate(0,-15/scale);ctx.rotate(lean);}
  if(p.flash>0)ctx.filter='brightness(1.55)';
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
  ctx.drawImage(img,-m.footX,-m.footY,m.w,m.h);
  ctx.restore();

  if (p.callout.t > 0) {
    ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,p.callout.t*3);
    const yy=Math.max(178,p.y-p.c.spriteHeight-28);
    ctx.fillStyle='#06142ae8';ctx.strokeStyle=p.c.glow;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x-112,yy-17,224,34);ctx.strokeRect(p.x-112,yy-17,224,34);
    text(p.callout.text,p.x,yy,16,'#fff2cf');ctx.restore();
  }
}

function drawBG() {
  const plate=safeImage(`arena-${game.stage.id}`);
  const time=stageClock;
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;ctx.imageSmoothingQuality='high';
  // Full source composition, downsampled once. No cover crop, faux inset,
  // enlarged low-resolution copy or blur border.
  if(plate)ctx.drawImage(plate,0,0,W,H);
  else rect(0,0,W,H,'#17304b');
  drawStageAmbient(game.stage,time);
  const shade=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  shade.addColorStop(0,'#03102010');shade.addColorStop(.7,'#03102000');shade.addColorStop(1,'#03102022');
  rect(0,0,W,H,shade);
}

function drawStageAmbient(stage,t) {
  ctx.save();
  // Atmospheric movement stays behind combatants. These are stage animations,
  // separate from the hit-only fighter VFX queue.
  if(stage.id==='batanes') {
    ctx.lineWidth=1.2;
    for(let i=0;i<25;i++) {
      const x=600+(i*43)%500,y=361+(i*23)%159;
      const a=.035+Math.max(0,Math.sin(t*1.7+i*1.9))*.12;
      ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(230,251,255,${a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x+Math.sin(t+i)*6,y,5+i%13,1.3,0,0,Math.PI);ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle='#11293280';ctx.lineWidth=1.8;
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++) {
      const x=(t*(12+i*3)+i*185)%900+175,y=187+i*31+Math.sin(t*.6+i)*9;
      const flap=Math.sin(t*4+i)*4;
      ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-7,y+flap);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x-3,y-3,x,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x+3,y-3,x+7,y+flap);ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if(stage.id==='butuan') {
    for(const [x,y] of [[28,355],[402,225],[1148,385],[1250,365]]) {
      const size=30+Math.sin(t*7+x)*4+Math.cos(t*11)*2;
      const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,size);
      g.addColorStop(0,'#ffcb673d');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffb64e00');rect(x-size,y-size,size*2,size*2,g);
    }
    for(let i=0;i<21;i++) {
      const y=413+(i*11)%65,x=622+(i*47)%341;
      ctx.globalAlpha=.04+Math.max(0,Math.sin(t*1.4+i))*.10;
      ctx.fillStyle='#ffe5a0';ctx.fillRect(x+Math.sin(t+i)*5,y,7+i%19,1.2);
    }
  } else if(stage.id==='vigan') {
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++) {
      const x=(i*340+t*12)%(W+300)-150,y=395+(i%2)*36;
      const mist=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,170);
      mist.addColorStop(0,'#b8c4fa0c');mist.addColorStop(1,'#b8c4fa00');rect(x-180,y-80,360,160,mist);
    }
    for(const [x,y] of [[111,208],[276,244],[1022,246],[1179,209]]) {
      const size=20+Math.sin(t*2.1+x)*2;
      const glow=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,size);
      glow.addColorStop(0,'#ffd4902d');glow.addColorStop(1,'#ffbf6900');rect(x-size,y-size,size*2,size*2,glow);
    }
  } else {
    for(let i=0;i<12;i++) {
      const x=(i*111+t*(4+i%3))%(W+40)-20,y=230+(i*37)%180+Math.sin(t+i)*7;
      ctx.globalAlpha=.14+Math.sin(t*1.4+i)*.08;ctx.fillStyle='#ffdc8c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawFX() {

  ctx.save();
  for (const v of visuals) {
    const k = 1 - v.time / v.life;
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - k) * 0.45;
    ctx.strokeStyle = v.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = (1 - k) * 9;
    ctx.shadowColor = v.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(v.x, v.y, v.size * k, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (const p of particles) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, p.t * 1.5);
    ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function bar(x, y, p, reverse) {
  const width = 425;
  const height = 30;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#060d1bcc';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 4, y - 4, width + 8, height + 8);
  const fill = Math.max(0, p.hp / 100);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.side === 0 ? '#5caafa' : '#fa755e';
  if (reverse) ctx.fillRect(x + width * (1 - fill), y, width * fill, height);
  else ctx.fillRect(x, y, width * fill, height);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff55');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#00000066');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(x, y, width, height);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#f2cf83';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(x, y, width, height);
  text(p.c.name, reverse ? x + width : x, y - 22, 26, '#fff4cb', reverse ? 'right' : 'left');
  const mx = reverse ? x + width - 162 : x;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#08192b';
  ctx.fillRect(mx, 92, 162, 12);
  ctx.fillStyle = p.c.glow;
  ctx.fillRect(reverse ? mx + 162 - 162 * (p.meter / 100) : mx, 92, 162 * (p.meter / 100), 12);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#e1b76e';
  ctx.strokeRect(mx, 92, 162, 12);
  text(`POWER ${Math.floor(p.meter)}%`, reverse ? x + width : x, 116, 15, p.c.color, reverse ? 'right' : 'left');
  for (let i = 0; i < ROUNDS_TO_WIN; i++) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#eacc8a';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(reverse ? x + width - 14 - i * 33 : x + 14 + i * 33, 135, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    if (game.wins[p.side] > i) {
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffe083';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(reverse ? x + width - 14 - i * 33 : x + 14 + i * 33, 135, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function hud() {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#05101cda';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, 165);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c99f5477';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, 165);
  ctx.lineTo(W, 165);
  ctx.stroke();
  bar(36, 52, game.a, false);
  bar(819, 52, game.b, true);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#112139';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d1a752';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(576, 15);
  ctx.lineTo(704, 15);
  ctx.lineTo(722, 53);
  ctx.lineTo(704, 104);
  ctx.lineTo(576, 104);
  ctx.lineTo(558, 53);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  text(Math.ceil(game.timer).toString().padStart(2, '0'), 640, 54, 76, '#ffda92');
  text(`ROUND ${game.round}  ·  FIRST TO ${ROUNDS_TO_WIN}`, 640, 124, 20, '#f8d8a3');
  if (game.cpu) text(`STAGE ${game.stageIndex+1}/1 · ${game.difficulty.name} CPU`,640,148,14,'#9ccfe6');
  if (game.a.combo > 1 && game.a.comboTimer) text(`${game.a.combo} HIT COMBO!`, 166, 220, 37, game.a.c.color);
  if (game.b.combo > 1 && game.b.comboTimer) text(`${game.b.combo} HIT COMBO!`, 1106, 220, 37, game.b.c.color);
  ctx.restore();
}

function render() {
  if (!game) return;
  ctx.save();
  // An opaque clear prevents stale edge pixels during camera shake.
  rect(0,0,W,H,'#08101b');
  if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake);
  drawBG();
  fighterSprite(game.a);
  fighterSprite(game.b);
  drawFX();
  ctx.restore();
  hud();

  if (game.state === 'intro') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#03091a7c';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 165, W, 500);
    text(`ROUND ${game.round}`, W / 2, 305, 93, '#fff3d0');
    if (game.intro < 1.35) text('FIGHT!', W / 2, 430, 124, '#ffc46a');
  }
  if (game.state === 'ko') {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#050b17a0';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 250, W, 255);
    const title = game.timer <= 0 ? 'TIME UP!' : 'K.O.!';
    text(title, W / 2, 366, 154, '#ffd07b');
  }
  ctx.fillStyle='#041120b8';ctx.fillRect(470,679,340,27);
  text(game.stage.name,640,692,17,'#ffdfa5');
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
}

function loop(now) {
  rafId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const elapsed=Math.min(.075,Math.max(0,(now-last)/1000));last=now;
  if(screen!=='fight'||!game){accumulator=0;return;}
  accumulator+=elapsed;
  while(accumulator>=1/120){update(1/120);accumulator-=1/120;}
  frame++;render();
}

window.addEventListener('gamepadconnected', () => console.info('Controller connected. Use left stick, A/B/X/Y and left trigger.'));
window.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => {
  if (e.target.closest('#touch')) e.preventDefault();
});

$('pauseBtn').onclick=()=>{if(canPauseGame())togglePause();};
$('fullBtn').onclick=async()=>{
